title: pentas micrantha subsp. wyliei
intro: Pentas micrantha subsp. wyliei, commonly known as the Wylie's Pentas, is a plant species belonging to the family Rubiaceae. This plant is valued for its health benefits, particularly in traditional medicine, where it is used to treat various ailments such as fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Wylie's Pentas include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antipyretic properties, which contribute to its medicinal value. Bioactive constituents such as alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins have been identified in this plant, which may be responsible for its therapeutic actions.
